Your field notes

Your work stays in this browser.

As you work through a lab, this browser remembers your place and the answers you enter. You can return to them here later, but they will not automatically appear on another device or in Quest. Someone else using this same browser can also see the saved attempt.

If you want a copy to keep, print your field notes or download the results before starting over for another learner. Starting over replaces the saved attempt, and clearing this site’s browser data also removes it.
